newsitem.title: USA: AT&T to guarantee Net commerce charges.
newsitem.headline: AT&T to guarantee Net commerce charges.

text.p: AT&T Corp said it will offer a secure method of transacting electronic commerce over the Internet and offered a series of security guarantees to entice customer to take advantage of the new shopping medium.
The company said the new offerings will stimulate the "Web economy" as 800 toll-free service stimulated telephony-based commerce beginning in the 1980s.
The telecommunciations giant said it would offer guaranteed credit card transaction security for Web shoppers -- backed by the industry's most comprehensive set of Internet satisfaction guarantees.
AT&T said that merchants that sign up for its SecureBuy Service by January 31, 1997, will receive the first 500 online transactions processed every month free for one year.
It said businesses can order the service now, with availability beginning November 15.
The company said it is offering three Internet service guarantees that expand the Web's potential for commerce -- for both merchants and consumers.
In addition, AT&T said it is offering its Web site hosting customers an "Internet Server Availability" guarantee that assures their sites will be open for business 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
It said this feature would virtually eliminate the "server not available" response Web surfers often receive when trying to contact popular Internet sites.
The company said that in the unlikely event that the AT&T server is unavailable the customer can receive a credit equal to one month's service fee per quarter.

AT&T said its new electronic commerce services, which it claimed were the most comprehensive in the industry, would include a turnkey system for businesses to design, build and maintain their own Web sites.
In addition, it plans to offer businesses new ways of attracting Web-surfing consumers to their sites.
In a statement, AT&T Chairman Robert Allen said that, "AT&T revolutionized business with the invention of 800 toll-free service, and we intend to do no less for Web-based commerce."
"Today we're introducing end-to-end solutions for Web commerce that will create new markets, attract new customers and turn 'browsers' into buyers."

As an added consumer incentive, surfers who join the AT&T SecureBuyer's Program will receive an AT&T SecureBuy Promotional Card valid for 100 free minutes of AT&T long-distance calls after spending $25 online at one or more of the AT&T hosted SecureBuy Web sites.
